gloss: to be taught, to learn from

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {教|おそ}わっていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be taught, to learn from
definitions.explanation: To receive instruction or knowledge from someone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{教|おそ}わった。
examples.english: I was taught Japanese by my teacher.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{教|おそ}わる。
examples.english: I learn cooking from my mother.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{多|おお}くの→多い：01127_ooi⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{教|おそ}わった。
examples.english: I learned many things from him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ギター→ギター：04461_gitaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{弾|ひ}き→弾く：02444_hiku⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{教|おそ}わった。
examples.english: I learned how to play guitar from a friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頃|ころ}→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧、⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{編|あ}み{物|もの}→編み物：06364_amimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{教|おそ}わったこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えている→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
examples.english: I still remember being taught knitting by my grandmother when I was a child.

notes:
{教|おそ}わる is an intransitive godan verb meaning 'to be taught' or 'to learn from someone.'

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- Pair: ⟦{教|おし}える→教える：00526_oshieru⟧ (transitive, to teach)

COMMON PATTERNS:
[person]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ [subject]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ {教|おそ}わる = to learn [subject] from [person]

EXAMPLES:
- ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{教|おそ}わる: to learn Japanese from a teacher
- ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{教|おそ}わった: I learned cooking from my mother
- ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多く：18752_ooku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{教|おそ}わった: I learned a lot from him

CONTRAST WITH ⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧:
- {教|おそ}わる emphasizes receiving instruction from someone
- ⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧ is more general 'to learn/take lessons'

Both use the pattern [person]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧...⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧, but {教|おそ}わる highlights the teaching relationship.

ASPECT (ている):
- {教|おそ}わって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: is currently being taught / has been taught (by someone) (ongoing or experiential)
- Note: {教|おそ}わって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ can describe either an ongoing learning relationship (⟦{田中|たなか}→田中：09528_tanaka⟧⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{教|おそ}わって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = "I am being taught math by Tanaka") or a habitual attendance at lessons. For a one-time past instance of learning something, use the plain past {教|おそ}わった.
